user.title: Set up Sleep Tracker
user.description: This will install the Sleep Tracker integration. Each user can then enable sleep tracking from the sidebar panel.

list_sessions.name: List sessions
list_sessions.description: List sessions with their export state and revision, oldest first. Returns the result as response data. Admin only.

tracker_id.name: Tracker ID
tracker_id.description: Only return sessions of this tracker.

finalized.name: Finalized
finalized.description: Only return sessions whose finalized flag matches.

exported.name: Exported
exported.description: Only return sessions whose exported flag matches.

get_session.name: Get session
get_session.description: Return the export payload of a completed session, identical to what the REST export posts, plus the session revision. Admin only.

mark_exported.name: Mark session exported
mark_exported.description: Set or clear the exported flag of a session. Marking exported requires a finalized session; clearing is always allowed. Admin only.

revision.name: Revision
revision.description: Optional. The revision returned by get_session. When marking exported, refused unless it equals the session's current revision.

export_session.name: Export session
export_session.description: Export a finalized sleep session to the configured REST endpoint. Fails, and leaves the session unexported, if it is changed while the request is in flight.

session_id.name: Session ID
session_id.description: The UUID of the session to export.
